items: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line. Up to 2000 characters

Formatting: **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, `code`, code blocks (three backticks around them), "> " at the start of a line for a quote, and ||spoilers|| (click to reveal). A backslash before a star (`\*`) shows a real one
Maths (LaTeX): $\frac{a}{b}$ in a sentence, $$...$$ for a formula on its own line. Money stays money: "$5 and $10" isn't maths, and `\$` always shows a real $
Hover a message to react 😀, reply ↩, edit ✏️ or delete 🗑️ (hold Shift to skip the question). Esc cancels a reply or an edit
↑ in an empty text box edits your last message
Click a reply's quote to jump to the original message (older ones load by themselves)

A red line marked NEW shows where you stopped reading in a chat (also for messages that came while you were away from the window). Lots of new ones? The chat opens at the line. It goes away when you write something
Pin a message: hover over it and click 📌. The 📌 at the top of a channel, DM or group lists its pinned messages (up to 100), with Jump and Unpin. Anyone can pin and unpin
@name mentions someone, @everyone mentions everybody: they get a notification and a red count
Type :name for emoji suggestions (↑↓ to choose, Enter or Tab to pick), or use the 😀 button. Messages with only emoji show them big
Pictures and files up to 10 MB: the + button, drag and drop, or paste. Up to 10 at once, click a picture to see it big
GIFs: the GIF button next to the text box. Type to search (from GIPHY), or pick one of the trending ones, and click one to send it (as a reply, if you're replying). Esc closes it
Links are clickable, and the first link in a message gets a preview card: the site, title, description and picture
Scroll up to load older messages, all the way to the beginning

Search: the 🔍 at the top of a chat. Type words (the start of a word is enough: "piz" finds pizza), choose this chat or everywhere, and type a name in From to only see one person's messages (pick them from the suggestions). Jump takes you to the message
Invite a friend: People → Invite someone makes a link that lets one person make an account, within a week. Copy it and send it to them. New accounts confirm their email with a link before they get in
People (at the top of the sidebar): your Friends, Everyone on the chat (with a search box, to find someone and add them), friend Requests and the people you Blocked
Friends: send requests and accept them on the People page. DMs are between friends. A new request pings you (and your phone, with notifications on)

Block someone: Block in their profile (click their name or picture). You stop being friends, they can't send you requests or reach you, and their messages are hidden for you ("Show" to see one). They aren't told. Unblock them in their profile or on the People page's Blocked tab. Admins and bots can't be blocked

Group DMs: the + next to "Direct messages" starts a private chat with 2 to 9 friends. At the top of a group: Add people (your own friends), Rename and Leave. Every message there notifies the others, like a DM. 📞 Call rings everyone in the group; whoever answers joins, and the rest can join later from the call banner. Chattus is in every group: write @Chattus to ask him something there
Online and offline people on the right, and "is typing…" under the messages
Roles: admins make roles with a colour in Settings → Roles and give them to people. A role colours its people's names and gives them a section in the member list; the roles show in their profile
The member list on the right shows who's in the chat you're in: everyone in a channel, the two of you in a DM, the members of a group

Your status: click your name at the bottom left and pick Online, Idle, Do Not Disturb (no notifications or sounds, on any device) or Invisible (you look offline but can chat as usual). After 10 minutes away from the chat you show as Idle by yourself. The dot on a picture shows it: green, yellow, red or grey
Click someone's picture or name for their profile: picture, banner, status and bio

Right-click someone (a long press on a phone): above their messages, in the member list, the DM list, the People page or a call. A menu with Profile, Mention, Message, Call, Add or Remove friend, Mute DM and Block
Your own in Settings → Profile. Pictures and banners can be animated GIFs, and you can move and zoom them
Up to 12 custom emoji of your own (also animated) in Settings → Emoji, for messages and reactions
The Lounge: a voice channel anyone can join. 📞 in a DM calls your friend, and it rings on all their devices
🎤 mute and 🎧 deafen at the bottom left. 📷 camera and 🖥️ screen sharing (up to 1440p and 60 fps, with your PC's sound but not the call's) in calls and the Lounge

Click a tile to make it big, right-click it for the profile. ⛶ or double-click a screen for fullscreen, where the others float in a small window: drag it to any corner, or hide it with 👥. In a DM, drag the call's bottom edge to resize it
Volume per person (0–200%) in their profile: click them, also in the voice list. A shared screen has its own volume: hover over it for the slider
Settings → Voice & audio: microphone, speakers, volumes, sensitivity and noise suppression. Settings → Video: your camera, with a preview
The signal icon in a call shows your ping. Click it for details, including how a screen share is doing (frame rate, data, and whether the graphics card encodes it)
Sharing one browser window and covering it with another window makes the share go black (the browser stops drawing covered windows). Share the entire screen instead, or keep the window uncovered
For DMs and mentions: a notification, a sound and a count in the tab's title. Click one to go to the message
Unread channels get a dot, mentions a red count

Mute a chat: the 🔔 at the top of a channel, DM or group (🔕 when muted, click again to unmute). A muted chat is faded and gets no unread dot or notifications, except when someone @mentions you by name or an admin writes. DMs with an admin can't be muted
Settings → Notifications: turn them on or off, the volume, and mute them for 1 hour, 8 hours, until morning, or until you turn them back on

On your phone, also while the chat is closed: Settings → Notifications → "Notifications on this device when the chat is closed". For DMs, mentions and calls, and not while you're looking at the chat somewhere else or have the Windows app open (it notifies you itself)
Real Windows notifications, and it updates itself. Get it in Settings or at chat.datslok.no/download
Settings → App behaviour: start ChatApp when Windows starts (on from the start; turn it off there or in Task Manager → Startup apps)
Install the chat as an app: open it on your phone and tap Install in the banner (or Chrome's ⋮ menu, Install app; iPhone: Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen). Its own icon and window, no address bar
Chattus is a friendly cat who answers everything in #chattus, and anywhere else when you write @Chattus. He has a BOT tag, and his own Bots section at the top of the member list
Everyone is his friend from the start, so you can DM him anytime
He knows how the chat works (everything on this page): ask him where a setting is or how to do something

In a DM with a friend, write @Chattus to ask him something there: he only answers when mentioned. Mentioning him lets him read that DM's latest messages for an hour (and like everything he reads, they go to his AI, Claude, to answer)
He reacts to messages too (🎉 for good news, 🐾 for a thanks), and knows our own emoji by name
He can see pictures: send one in #chattus (or with @Chattus), or ask about the pictures above (up to 3 of the last few), small text in them too
He searches the web when he needs fresh facts. Start with "search:" to make him search the web, or "wiki:" for Wikipedia. The search engines only get his search words, never the chat
He writes maths as real formulas, like $E = mc^2$
He reads links: post one and ask what it says, or for a summary. Some big sites (like recipe sites) don't let him in
He reads files: PDFs (up to 5 MB, scans too) and text files like notes, code or a .csv. Ask about the file you send, or one just above

He shows pictures: ask him for photos of a place, an animal or a thing ("show us Halden prison"). He finds real photos on Wikimedia Commons, picks the best few and posts them, each with its photographer. He can't make pictures, or find private ones
He rolls dice: ask him ("roll a d20"), or write "roll: 2d6" (up to 20 dice, and a bonus like "1d20+3")
He makes polls: ask him, or write "poll: Friday dinner? pizza, sushi, tacos". Vote by clicking a number under it (up to 10 options)

He reminds you: "remind me tomorrow at 9 to call mum", "in 20 minutes", "on friday at 18" (or "remind: ..."). He says when he understood, and pings you then, up to a year ahead. Asked in a DM between friends, the reminder comes in your DM with him

He thinks with Claude Haiku, an AI from Anthropic: to answer, he sends it what he reads (a chat's last 200 messages, and pictures he looks at). Anthropic doesn't use it to train its AI. He can be wrong, and only knows the last messages of a channel

Settings: the ⚙️ at the bottom left, next to your name. Its tabs: My Account, Profile, Appearance, Emoji, Notifications, Voice & audio, Video, App behaviour (only in the Windows app), What's new and Bugs & ideas (admins also have Channels, Roles and Inbox)
Channels: admins add, rename, move and delete channels in Settings → Channels, and add headings that group the channels under them in the sidebar
My Account: change your username, email and password. A new email address only takes over once you click the link we send to it. Forgot your password? There's a link on the login page

Appearance: eight themes (Dark, Darker, Light, Blue, Purple, Green, Pink, Light pink), your own colours on top, a font and a text size, and in the Windows app a scale (everything bigger or smaller). Saved with your account, so it's the same on every device
What's new: what changed lately (a red dot on ⚙️ means something new), and everything the chat can do
Bugs & ideas: tell us what's broken or what you'd like
Invite friends with a link 💌: People → Invite someone (each link works once, for a week). New accounts confirm their email address first, and so does a new address in Settings
GIFs 🎞️: the new GIF button next to the text box searches GIPHY. Click one to send it

The member list on the right now shows who's in the chat you're in (a DM: the two of you, a group: its members). Everyone is on the new Everyone tab of the People page (the old Friends page), with a search box
A red NEW line shows where you stopped reading in a chat, and opening a chat with lots of new messages starts there
New channels and headings can show up in the sidebar: admins now manage them from the app (Settings → Channels)
Group DMs 👥: click the + next to "Direct messages" to start a private chat with up to 9 friends, with group calls 📞. Chattus is in every group: @Chattus to ask him something
Chattus shows pictures 📷: ask him for photos of a place, an animal or a thing, and he posts a few real ones from Wikimedia Commons
No more double notifications: while the Windows app is open on your PC, your phone stays quiet (the app notifies you)
Fixed: the category buttons at the top of the emoji picker can jump back up again (after jumping down to flags, say)
Settings → Voice & audio lists your microphones and speakers straight away, without pressing Test microphone first
Windows app 0.1.18: fixes the app forgetting your audio settings (and showing the What's new dot again) every time it starts. After this update, set your audio settings once more and they'll stick
Pinned messages 📌: hover over a message and click 📌 to pin it, and click 📌 at the top of the chat to see them all
Search 🔍: find messages by their words, in one chat or everywhere, from anyone or one person. The 🔍 is at the top of every chat
Statuses: click your name at the bottom left for Online, Idle, Do Not Disturb or Invisible. You also turn Idle by yourself after 10 minutes away
Mute a chat 🔕: the 🔔 at the top of a channel, DM or group. You still hear about @mentions of you, and anything from an admin
Blocking 🚫: Block in someone's profile hides their messages and stops them reaching you. Unblock on the Friends page's Blocked tab
Friend requests now ping you 👋, with a notification that opens your requests (on your phone too)
Right-click anyone (or long press on a phone) for a menu: profile, mention, message, call, add or remove friend, mute and block
Roles 🎨: coloured names and member list sections, made by admins in Settings → Roles
Picking people is a search now: type a name to add someone to a role, and the New group popup has a search box over your friends
Chattus rolls dice 🎲: ask him to roll a d20, or write "roll: 2d6"
Chattus makes polls 📊: ask him, or write "poll: Friday dinner? pizza, sushi, tacos", then vote with the numbers under it

Chattus got a new brain 🧠: he now thinks with Claude Haiku, an AI from Anthropic, instead of the one on our server. He's smarter and quicker, and looks things up when he isn't sure. This does mean what he reads to answer (a chat's last 200 messages, pictures he looks at) now goes to Anthropic
Chattus is more catlike, nya~ :3
Chattus searches the web better: he finds fresh news and results that he often couldn't before
Chattus reminds you ⏰: "remind me tomorrow at 9 to call mum", and he pings you then
Chattus remembers much more: a chat's last 200 messages instead of 20. Ask him "what did I miss?"
Chattus reads links 🔗: post one and ask "what does this say?" or "summarize this" (some big sites don't let him in)
Chattus reads files 📄: send a PDF or a text file (notes, code, a .csv) and ask him about it
Chattus sees pictures better 👀: several at once ("which of these is cuter?"), and sharp enough to read small text in screenshots and photos
Chattus knows what he looks like, so he no longer thinks every cat picture is him
Bots have their own section at the top of the member list, and a BOT tag after their name
Everyone is friends with Chattus now: DM him anytime, no friend request needed
Chattus knows how the chat works: ask him where a setting is or how to do something
Fixed: @name and :emoji suggestions now also work when you edit a message
Windows app 0.1.17: ChatApp now starts when Windows starts. Don't want that? Turn it off in Settings → App behaviour (it stays off)
Windows app 0.1.16: Settings → App behaviour can start ChatApp when Windows starts (it updates by itself)
Meet Chattus 🐱, an AI cat: talk to him in the new #chattus channel, @Chattus anywhere, or DM him (add him as a friend first)
Chattus in DMs with friends: write @Chattus in a DM and he answers there, only when mentioned. A mention lets him read that DM's latest messages for an hour (on our own server)
Chattus reacts: sometimes an emoji under your message instead of (or as well as) an answer, and he can use our own emoji
Chattus can see pictures: send him one, or ask about the picture above. He also knows what our own emoji look like
Chattus can search the web for fresh facts, with a link to where he found it. "search: ..." makes him look something up, "wiki: ..." on Wikipedia
Chattus writes maths as formulas ($...$), like everyone can
Chattus knows when messages were sent, and says so when something is too far back for him (he sees a chat's latest 20 messages)
Maths in messages: $x^2$ in a sentence, or $$\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx$$ for a formula on its own line (LaTeX, drawn like in a textbook)
Settings → Appearance: themes, your own colours, fonts and text size, the same on all your devices
The chat can be installed on your phone as an app: open it on your phone and tap Install in the banner
Notifications on your phone while the chat is closed: turn them on in Settings → Notifications (on the phone)
Opening a channel on your phone clears its notifications
Two pink themes in Settings → Appearance: Pink (dark) and Light pink
Lighter on your battery: the sound and noise suppression pause when nothing needs them (they kept running after a microphone test or a call)
Test microphone and Test camera say right below the button what went wrong, and where to allow them (also on Android phones)
A phone's back camera is no longer shown mirrored to you
Windows app 0.1.15: Settings → Appearance has a Scale slider to make everything bigger or smaller (it updates by itself)
Sending a message while scrolled up now takes you down to it
A volume slider for shared screens: hover over someone's screen and turn their video up or down without changing their voice
Fullscreen keeps everyone in view: double-click a shared screen, and the others float in a small window you can drag to any corner or hide with 👥
Sharing your screen with sound no longer sends the call back: the others don't hear themselves anymore
Text formatting: **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, `code`, code blocks, quotes and ||spoilers||
Scroll up in a channel to load older messages, all the way to the beginning
Settings → Bugs & ideas: tell us what's broken or what you'd like
You at the bottom left, like Discord: your picture, status, mute and deafen
What's new: this page, with a dot on ⚙️ when there's something new
Smoother screen sharing in games: encoded on the graphics card (H.264 hardware acceleration, like Discord's), and at 60 fps it keeps the frame rate instead of dropping frames
The connection popup shows how screen shares are doing
Link previews: paste a link and a card with its title, description and picture appears under the message
datslok.no now has a page about ChatApp, to send to people who want to know what it is
A new cat icon by Niamh, in the browser tab and the Windows app (it updates by itself)
Screen sharing in calls and the Lounge, up to 1440p and 60 fps, with sound
Camera in DM calls and the Lounge, with a tile for everyone (click one to make it big)
Voice: the Lounge voice channel, calls in DMs, volume per person, and noise suppression
In a call: a signal icon with your ping, and a connection popup
The Windows app, with real notifications and automatic updates
Clickable links, and clicking a notification takes you to the message
F5 keeps you in the channel you were in
Custom emoji: replace the picture (old messages show the new one)
The beginning: channels, DMs and friends, profiles with pictures and banners, pictures and files
Replies, reactions, custom emoji, editing and deleting, @mentions
Notifications for DMs and mentions, with a volume slider and mute
